parts.text: I have a sharp, stabbing pain in my chest that radiates to my left arm.
I am transferring you to the Cardiologist immediately to evaluate your chest pain and radiating arm pain.
My heart feels like it's skipping beats and I feel very lightheaded.
You should speak with our Cardiologist about these palpitations and lightheadedness right away.
I've had a throbbing headache for two days and I'm sensitive to light.
I am connecting you with the Neurologist to discuss your persistent headache and light sensitivity.
My friend just had a brief period of uncontrolled shaking and loss of consciousness.
I'm transferring you to the Neurologist for urgent consultation regarding the loss of consciousness and shaking.
I have a persistent dry cough and I can hear a wheezing sound when I breathe.
The Pulmonologist will help you with that persistent cough and wheezing.
I get extremely short of breath even after walking a very short distance.
I am referring you to the Pulmonologist for your shortness of breath during exertion.
I have intense pain in my lower back near my ribs and it hurts when I urinate.
The Nephrologist is the right specialist for your back pain and urinary discomfort.
My ankles are very swollen and I noticed my urine has become very dark.
Let's have the Nephrologist check those swollen ankles and the change in urine color.
I have severe abdominal cramping and constant bloating after every meal.
I am transferring you to the Gastrologist to investigate your abdominal cramping and bloating.
I have frequent acid reflux and a sour taste in my mouth after eating.
The Gastrologist will assist you with your acid reflux and sour taste symptoms.
Hello, who are you and how can you help me today?
Hello, I am the Receptionist. I can help triage your symptoms and connect you with the appropriate specialist.
I just don't feel well overall, I'm tired and have a low fever.
I'm sorry you're not feeling well. To help me find the right specialist, could you tell me more about any specific pains or other symptoms?
Actually, my stomach has been hurting a lot lately, please help me with it
I understand. I'll connect you with our Gastrologist to address your stomach pain.
I want to know about the latest heart surgery techniques.
The Cardiologist can provide you with information on the latest heart surgery techniques.
My blood pressure is 160/100 and I have a headache.
That's a high blood pressure reading. I am transferring you to the Cardiologist immediately.
